correctness.rationale: For a fixed labelled r-point strict poset Q on the distinct new tuple, each named antichain parameter has a locally valid below/above/incomparable pattern (L,U): L upper in Q, U lower in Q, all U strictly below all L. Joint transitivity with n mutually incomparable parameters holds iff their global L and U unions are disjoint. A bit orientation per tuple vertex realizes any compatible family; inclusion-exclusion over the 2^r templates gives T_r(n) as an integer combination of j^n, 0<=j<=3^r, proving rationality for every FIXED r. For r=2 the two chain orders each contribute 4^n+2*3^n-2*2^n, and incomparability contributes 2*4^n+2*3^n-4*2^n+1; total 4*4^n+6*3^n-8*2^n+1. All four bases have nonzero coefficients, giving minimal recurrence order 4. Fresh independent direct transitivity enumeration yielded n=0..4 totals 3,19,87,355,1383; fixed-arity proof is not finite inference. Reconstructed assigned eight-file Git tree matches SHA c50e64b3cb1f3a5cf8c69fbc2ef349d570ca09f9. A further independent direct full-poset transitivity enumeration covered n=5 and returned 5299, matching the formula.
